builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: A two-handed weapon and Seal of Command from level 20. Simple to play: you hit hard and can heal yourself between fights.
builds.gear: Strength first, then Stamina. A two-handed sword, axe or mace, and the heaviest armor you can wear.

why.Benediction: Seals and other instant spells cost less Mana, so you can fight longer.
why.Conviction: More critical strikes with every attack and spell.
why.Improved Judgement: Judgement is ready again sooner, so you use it more often.
why.Seal of Command: A Seal that adds extra Holy damage to your hits, from level 20.
why.Sanctified Judgement: Judgement gives back Mana from your Seal, so fights cost you less.
why.Pursuit of Justice: You run faster, on foot and on a mount.
why.Two-Handed Weapon Specialization: More damage with a two-handed weapon, but enemies notice you less.
why.Sacred Arbiter: Holy Strike hits harder and keeps your Judgements on the enemy fresh.
why.Eye for an Eye: Enemies that crit you take some of the pain themselves.
why.Vengeance: After a critical strike, you deal more damage for a while.
why.Repentance: Holds one Humanoid enemy still until you hit it, and it opens Unsealed Wrath.
why.Champion of the Light: Your spells do more damage, based on your Intellect.
why.Unsealed Wrath: Your hits store extra Seal effects that go off when you change Seals.
why.Divine Strength: More Strength, so your weapon hits harder.
why.Healing Light: Holy Light and Flash of Light heal you for more.
why.Reverence: You keep some Mana regeneration while casting, handy when you heal.
why.Divine Precision: Your Holy spells miss less, and Silence effects on you end sooner.
why.Spiritual Focus: Your heals are less likely to be interrupted when you are hit.
why.Vindication: Your hits sometimes make the enemy weaker, so it hits you less hard.
why.Holy Conduit: Consecration, Exorcism and Holy Wrath cost less Mana.

fight: Cast Seal of Righteousness before the fight, then hit the enemy with your weapon.
Use Judgement every time it is ready.
Use Holy Strike for extra damage when you have Mana to spare.
Seal of Command
Seal of Command (level 20) adds more Holy damage. Use it instead of Seal of Righteousness.
Repentance
Repentance, a late talent, holds one Humanoid still. Two at once? Hold one, kill the other.
Health low? Cast Holy Light between fights, or Flash of Light in a pinch.
In real danger, use Lay on Hands, a big heal you can only use now and then.

builds.name: Dungeon healer
builds.suits: Heal your group with Holy Light and Flash of Light. You also wear heavy armor, so you can take a hit if an enemy gets to you.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Stamina and Spirit. Look for gear that adds healing, and a shield or a held item.

why.Divine Intellect: More Intellect, which means more Mana for healing.
why.Spiritual Focus: Flash of Light and Holy Light are less likely to be slowed when you are hit.
why.Healing Light: Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock heal for more.
why.Reverence: Part of your Mana comes back while you cast, so you can heal for longer.
why.Divine Favor: Makes your next heal a critical heal, which is an extra-big one.
why.Illumination: A critical heal can give you some Mana back.
why.Holy Conduit: Consecration, Exorcism and Holy Wrath cost less Mana.
why.Divine Precision: Your Holy spells miss less, and Silence effects on you end sooner.
why.Infusion of Light: After a critical Holy Shock or Flash of Light, your next Holy Light casts faster.
why.Oath of Light: Swear an Oath to one friend, and your heals on that friend heal more.
why.Holy Shock: Hurts an enemy or heals a friend.
why.Purifying Power: Cleanse and Purify cost less Mana, and Exorcism and Holy Wrath are ready sooner.
why.Boundless Light: Holy Shock gets more critical heals on friends who do not have your Oath.
why.Holy Power: Your critical heals heal even more.
why.Light's Vigil: Your next Holy Shock on that friend has no wait and heals their party too.
why.Guardian's Favor: Blessing of Protection is ready sooner, and Blessing of Freedom lasts longer.
why.Sacred Duty: Divine Shield and Divine Protection are ready sooner, and Forbearance wears off faster.
why.Precision: You miss a little less often with attacks.
why.Templar's Bulwark: A big shield around you for emergencies.
why.Improved Hammer of Justice: Hammer of Justice, a stun, is ready again sooner.
why.Toughness: More Armor from your gear, so you take less damage.

fight: Use Flash of Light for quick small heals, and Holy Light for slow, big ones.
Cast Blessing of Wisdom (level 14) on party members who use Mana, and on yourself.
Divine Favor
Divine Favor makes your next heal a critical heal. Save it for an emergency.
Holy Shock
Holy Shock heals a friend, or hurts an enemy. Use it whenever it is ready.
Lay on Hands saves a friend about to die. You can use it only now and then.
Hammer of Justice stuns an enemy that is hitting your friend.
Low on Mana? Stop healing those who are fine, and drink between fights.

builds.name: Dungeon tank
builds.suits: Hold the enemies' attention in a dungeon with a shield and Righteous Fury, and take hits while your group does the damage.
builds.gear: Stamina first, then Strength and Armor. A shield and a one-handed weapon, and the heaviest armor you can wear.

why.Redoubt: After you are hit, you sometimes block more for a while.
why.Precision: You miss a little less often with attacks.
why.Sacred Duty: Divine Shield and Divine Protection are ready sooner, and Forbearance wears off faster.
why.Toughness: More Armor from your gear, so you take less damage.
why.Templar's Bulwark: A big shield around you for emergencies.
why.Shield Specialization: Your shield absorbs more damage, and blocks sometimes give you Mana.
why.Improved Righteous Fury: With Righteous Fury on, you take less damage.
why.Anticipation: More Defense, so enemies hit you less often.
why.Holy Shield: You block much more for a while, and enemies that you block take damage.
why.Reckoning: Blocking, and being critically hit, sometimes gives you a free extra attack.
why.Iron Creed: Holy Strike keeps more enemy attention on you, and with Righteous Fury it cuts damage you take.
why.Shieldsworn: Holy Strike is ready sooner, and works with your Holy Shield.
why.Divine Intellect: More Intellect, which means more Mana for healing yourself.
why.Divine Strength: More Strength, so your attacks hit harder.
why.Healing Light: Holy Light and Flash of Light heal for more, so you can heal yourself.
why.Reverence: Part of your Mana comes back while you cast.

fight: Turn on Righteous Fury before a fight. It makes enemies pay more attention to you.
Fight with a shield. Seal of Fury (level 10) gives you a small shield with each hit.
Use Judgement and Holy Strike every time they are ready. Hitting keeps their attention.
Judgement while Seal of Fury is on makes an enemy attack you. Use it on one hitting a friend.
Holy Shield
Holy Shield makes you block much more for a while. Use it before a hard hit.
Templar's Bulwark
Templar's Bulwark gives you a big shield. Save it for an emergency.
Health low? Cast Holy Light between fights, or Flash of Light in a pinch.
